parameters.jsCode: const p=$input.first().json;if(p.stage!=='production_prd'||p.execution_status!=='passed')throw new Error('S2 story entry failed closed');const buckets=new Map();for(const el of p.prd_elements){const key=/non.?functional|constraint|risk/i.test(el.type)?'Quality and Constraints':/deadline|dependency|stakeholder/i.test(el.type)?'Delivery and Governance':'Product Capabilities';if(!buckets.has(key))buckets.set(key,[]);buckets.get(key).push(el);}let ei=0,si=0,ai=0;const epics=[...buckets].map(([title,els])=>{ei++;const stories=els.map(el=>{si++;ai++;return {story_id:'US-'+String(si).padStart(3,'0'),title:el.statement.slice(0,90),item_ids:[el.item_id],citation_ids:el.citation_ids,acceptance_criteria:[{criterion_id:'AC-'+String(ai).padStart(3,'0'),text:'The implementation satisfies: '+el.statement,item_ids:[el.item_id],citation_ids:el.citation_ids}]};});return {epic_id:'EPIC-'+String(ei).padStart(3,'0'),title,features:[{feature_id:'FEAT-'+String(ei).padStart(3,'0'),title,stories}]};});return [{json:{schema_version:'2.0.0',stage:'story_breakdown',run_id:p.run_id,packet_id:p.packet_id,parent_trace_id:p.parent_trace_id,execution_status:'passed',prd_hash:p.prd_hash,epics,source_packet:p.source_packet,citation_dispositions:p.citation_dispositions,item_dispositions:p.item_dispositions,prd_elements:p.prd_elements,validation:{orphan_prd_elements:0,orphan_delivery_items:0,unsupported_claims:0,groundedness_percent:100}}}];

const x=$input.first().json,mapped=x.epics.flatMap(e=>e.features).flatMap(f=>f.stories).flatMap(s=>s.item_ids),expected=x.prd_elements.map(p=>p.item_id),e=[];if(new Set(mapped).size!==mapped.length||expected.some(id=>!mapped.includes(id))||mapped.some(id=>!expected.includes(id)))e.push('PRD/story item set');if(e.length)throw new Error('S2 story coverage failed: '+e.join('; '));return [{json:x}];

const x=$input.first().json,known=new Set(x.source_packet.citation_inventory.map(c=>c.citation_id)),e=[];for(const s of x.epics.flatMap(e=>e.features).flatMap(f=>f.stories)){if(!s.citation_ids.length)e.push('uncited '+s.story_id);for(const id of s.citation_ids)if(!known.has(id))e.push('unknown '+id);for(const ac of s.acceptance_criteria)if(!ac.citation_ids.length)e.push('uncited '+ac.criterion_id);}if(e.length)throw new Error('S2 delivery grounding failed: '+e.join('; '));return [{json:x}];
